items.name: theme
items.title: Ninaero theme
items.description: Shared light and dark tokens with Ninaero squircle Button styling.

theme.font-sans: 'Google Sans Flex Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

.ninaero-dialog.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--dialog-highlight), inset 0 -1px 2px var(--dialog-shade), 0 2px 3px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.12), 0 8px 12px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.08), 0 16px 28px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.04)

.ninaero-toggle.transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, border-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out

.ninaero-button.transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, border-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out, transform 80ms ease-out

.ninaero-button--secondary.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--button-paper-highlight), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--button-paper-shade), 0 1px 2px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.18), 0 2px 5px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.11), 0 4px 10px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.07)

.ninaero-button--destructive.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--button-destructive-highlight), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--button-destructive-shade), 0 1px 2px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.18), 0 2px 5px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.11), 0 4px 10px hsl(var(--shadow-color) / 0.07)

:root.--font-sans: 'Google Sans Flex Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
